criteria.requirement: Add funcy.relations.join_by(left,right,left_key,right_key=None,*,how="inner") and frozen JoinPair(left,right,left_present,right_present). Use exact string fields or real Funcy make_func index/callable selectors, materialize right once then lazily consume left, producing every duplicate-key Cartesian pair in left/right order. Support inner/left/full and append unmatched right rows in original order. None is a legal key/record distinguished from absence by presence flags, unhashable keys and callback/input errors propagate. Never mutate/merge record fields or silently overwrite duplicates; state right-side memory cost and leave existing collection join/group_by untouched.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
